name: ESO 006-G001 (Hubble)
blurb: ESO 006-G001, an isolated dwarf galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: eso006g001-hubble
story: A lonely dwarf galaxy near the Local Group, a transition dwarf whose light is dominated by old stars. Hubble imaged it in a program aiming to record every known nearby galaxy.

claims.text: ESO 006-001 is a transition dwarf dominated by old stars
It is an isolated dwarf galaxy and a near neighbor to the Local Group
Hubble imaged it in the SNAP program Every Known Nearby Galaxy
